name: Grade 6 T1 Practice: April Week 3 - Links and Navigation
description: Practice words for moving around a website and testing links.

words.definition: Something you click to open another page or place.
words.example: The link opened the class page.

words.definition: A list of choices or links.
words.example: The menu helped visitors choose a page.

words.definition: The first or main page of a website.
words.example: The home page introduced the project.

words.definition: How people move around a website.
words.example: Good navigation helps visitors find information.

words.definition: Something on a screen that you click or tap.
words.example: The button opened the next page.

words.definition: One screen or document in a website.
words.example: The website had a home page and a project page.

words.definition: To try something to see if it works.
Helpful comments about what works and what can improve.
words.example: A partner gave feedback about the menu.
